Coverage.description: covered + excluded + missing + unexplained == total_allocation (== 1 for a valid request).
Coverage.title: Coverage

CoverageReport.description: v3 C-COV: what is known, unknown and possibly missing about this portfolio's dependencies.
CoverageReport.title: CoverageReport

DependencyJob.description:
POST /api/dependencies returns this (HTTP 200 if done from cache, 202 otherwise); poll
GET /api/dependencies/{job_id} every 1-2 s until status is done or error.
DependencyJob.title: DependencyJob

EdgeImportance.description: v3 R-IMP: how much this relationship matters, scored deterministically in Python.
EdgeImportance.title: EdgeImportance

EdgeInterpretation.description:
v3 V-INT: does the verified quote really mean this relationship? Edges with status 'rejected'
never appear in DependencyResult.edges (they are counted in counts.interpretation_rejected).
EdgeInterpretation.title: EdgeInterpretation

EtfSummary.description: GET /api/etfs/{ticker}: one ETF without portfolio context.
EtfSummary.title: EtfSummary

NormalisedHolding.description: One security in one ETF. Duplicate source lines for the same security_key are summed.
NormalisedHolding.title: NormalisedHolding

PriceQuote.description: One ETF's latest market price, as published by a source (v2). Used to value share counts.
PriceQuote.title: PriceQuote

Sector.description: GICS-style sectors. Every source label maps onto one of these (unmapped -> unknown).
Sector.title: Sector

info.description: ETF look-through analysis on real holdings. Weights are fractions of 1.
info.title: House of Cards API

post.description: Same DependencyJob body either way: 200 when already finished (e.g. all cached), else 202.
Shares -> allocations. A blocked valuation is still 200, with status 'blocked' and its issues.
